# dsh-skill-recursive
Recursive `SKILL.md` discovery for DeepSeek Harness. The built-in provider reads one directory level
per skill root; this plugin adds skills stored in nested folders.

## Install
The plugin is a normal DSH bundle and works in both the Desktop app (`desktop` profile) and a browse
r-hosted harness (`web` profile). A profile only loads what is installed in it.

## Configure
Open **Settings → Plugins → Recursive Skill Discovery**. The bundle's page renders the configuration
form; changes are saved by DSH and applied without restarting.
| Field | Default | Meaning |

| `minDepth` | `2` | First directory depth (relative to a root) that may hold a skill. |
| `maxDepth

` | `8` | Deepest directory depth scanned. |
| `watch` | `true` | Watch roots and invalidate the cat

alog on change. |
| `debounceMs` | `200` | Debounce for watcher invalidations. |
| `pollIntervalMs`

| `2000` | Fallback polling interval. |
| `includeProjectRoots` | `true` | Scan project `.dsh/skills

` and `.agents/skills`. |
| `includeUserRoots` | `true` | Scan user-level skill roots. |
| `followSy

mlinks` | `false` | Follow symlinked directories (loop-guarded). |
| `extraRoots` | `[]` | Additiona

l roots; use absolute paths. |
| `ignoreDirs` | `[".system","node_modules",".git"]` | Directory name
s never descended into. |

## What it does
- **Roots** — project `.dsh/skills` and `.agents/skills` (nearest `.git` ancestor of the session cwd
), `$DSH_HOME/skills` (default `~/.dsh/skills`), `$DSH_AGENTS_HOME/skills` (default `~/.agents/skill

s`), plus any `extraRoots`.
- **Recursive scan** — walks each root to `maxDepth`, skipping `ignoreDi

rs`.
- **Depth guard** — contributes only nested bundles at depth 2 or deeper, so the built-in provi

der keeps ownership of flat skills.
- **Precedence** — nested candidates rank one step below the mat

ching flat root, so a same-name flat skill wins.
- **Frontmatter** — reads `name`, `description`, op
tional `whenToUse`, `disable-model-invocation`, and `user-invocable`; invalid files are logged and s

kipped.
- **Hot refresh** — watches roots and invalidates the skill catalog; falls back to polling w
here recursive watching is unavailable.
## Compatibility

- Tested with DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.5` and Node.js 20+.
- The settings form is rendered by the

same Web client in both the Desktop and Web profiles.
- Uses DSH's `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` for th
e settings schema; no other runtime dependency.
## Notes
- **Depth-1 ownership** — this plugin supplements `skill-filesystem`; if that provider is disabled,

flat skills are not discovered by this plugin alone.
- **Direct filesystem reads** — skill files are

read with `node:fs` from the host process, matching the built-in provider.
- **Frontmatter subset**
— plain/quoted scalars, block scalars (`|`, `>`), and booleans are supported; arbitrary nested YAML

is not forwarded.
- **Watchers** — one watcher is kept per distinct root path for the process lifet
